description: Compare each station's average bandwidth usage with the unweighted mean of the station averages.

a.request: Average the bandwidth usage (`bandusagepct`) of the telescopes at each observatory station, ignoring missing values. Take as the baseline the average of those station averages (each station counting once). For the stations whose average is above that baseline, return one row with two unrounded values: the mean of those stations' averages, and the mean amount by which they exceed the baseline.
a.sql: WITH station_averages AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS station_avg FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(station_avg) AS baseline_avg FROM station_averages) SELECT AVG(sa.station_avg) AS mean_station_average, AVG(sa.station_avg - b.baseline_avg) AS mean_excess_over_baseline FROM station_averages AS sa CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE sa.station_avg > b.baseline_avg

c.request: For observatory stations whose average telescope bandwidth usage (`bandusagepct`) is above average, what is their mean bandwidth usage, and how far above average are they on average? Ignore missing usage values, and give both figures unrounded in a single row. Compare each station's average bandwidth usage with the unweighted mean of the station averages.
c.sql: WITH station_averages AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS mean_bandwidth_usage FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(mean_bandwidth_usage) AS mean_station_usage FROM station_averages) SELECT AVG(s.mean_bandwidth_usage) AS mean_bandwidth_usage, AVG(s.mean_bandwidth_usage - o.mean_station_usage) AS mean_amount_above_average FROM station_averages AS s CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE s.mean_bandwidth_usage > o.mean_station_usage

b.request: Calculate each observatory station’s mean `bandusagepct` from non-null telescope values, then calculate the unweighted mean of those station means; in one row, return the unrounded mean usage of stations above that benchmark and their unrounded mean excess over it
b.sql: WITH station_means AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS mean_usage FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(mean_usage) AS mean_station_usage FROM station_means) SELECT AVG(s.mean_usage) AS mean_usage_above_benchmark, AVG(s.mean_usage - b.mean_station_usage) AS mean_excess_above_benchmark FROM station_means AS s CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE s.mean_usage > b.mean_station_usage;

d.request: For each observatory station, ignoring missing `bandusagepct` values, what is its average telescope bandwidth usage, and how does it compare with the unweighted mean of all stations’ averages? Give the values unrounded.
d.sql: WITH station_averages AS (SELECT o.observstation, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct FROM observatories AS o LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bandusagepct) AS mean_station_avg_bandusagepct FROM station_averages) SELECT s.observstation, s.avg_bandusagepct, o.mean_station_avg_bandusagepct, s.avg_bandusagepct - o.mean_station_avg_bandusagepct AS difference_from_mean FROM station_averages AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o ORDER BY s.observstation;
